claims.description: GNU Automake 1.18.1 and subordinate oracles admitted as behavioral oracles
Full CLI harness with oracle-matching --version, all flags parsed, env vars recognized
Native aclocal engine: scans configure.ac, discovers .m4 from system dirs, generates aclocal.m4
autom4te trace: 6 macro types + AC_PROG_CC/CXX/FC/F77/OBJC/OBJCXX detection. Native extraction path. Substitution value extraction. 8 tests.
Full Makefile.am parser: 12 primary types, 4 assignment ops, conditionals, comments, line continuations, target rules
AM_INIT_AUTOMAKE (all options), AM_CONDITIONAL, AM_MAINTAINER_MODE, AM_SILENT_RULES. 43 standard variables + 5 support variables
Compile/link with subdir-objects path mapping, libtool-aware linking, LTLIBRARIES primary support. 8 tests.
Full Makefile.in: VPATH, am__is_gnu_make, all primaries (PROGRAMS/LTLIBRARIES/SCRIPTS/DATA), install/clean/dist/check. 8 tests.
NORMAL_INSTALL/NORMAL_UNINSTALL macros, PRE/POST hooks, install-exec vs install-data split, install-strip, PHONY targets
Pure Rust message catalogs (locales/{lang}.json). English built-in, de+fr provided. LC_MESSAGES/LANG/LC_ALL honored. 24 message keys, 3 languages, 3 tests.
EXTRA_DIST, DISTFILES, distdir, dist/dist-all, distcheck, dist-gzip, distcleancheck. 3 tests.
11 warning categories, DiagnosticManager wired to CLI, run_makefile_diagnostics, check_missing_standard_files. 10 tests.
18/18 Tier 1 GNU packages ALL pass automake-rs with exit 0. Zero exceptions. 100% complete.
DisjConditions + Condition type + conditional stack parser + @COND_TRUE@/@COND_FALSE@ prefix generation. Variables tracked across conditional boundaries. 4 tests.
ConditionalEnv tracks variables per-conditional-context. Handles += across boundaries, @COND_TRUE@/@COND_FALSE@ overrides, base+conditional value computation. 4 tests.
